items.title: How to run AWS CLI command tasks in Ansible Tower
items.summary:
The AWS CLI command tasks in Ansible playbooks work fine form command line if AWS credentials are specified as environment variables as per boto requirements. More info can be found here [Environment Variables][1]. But they fail to run in Tower because it exports another set of env. vars:

AWS_ACCESS_KEY
AWS_SECRET_KEY

items.title: High FPS: AI reactions degrade above 100 fps
items.summary:
**EchoPatch:** "Degraded AI reactions" ([High FPS Fixes](https://github.com/Wemino/EchoPatch#high-fps-fixes)).

**Cause, confirmed in both builds:** each AI asks the engine to update it again in 0.01 s. Below 100 fps a frame is longer than that, so the AI updates every frame. At 120 fps (8.3 ms frames) it updates every other frame, and its timers (perception, reaction, decisions) advance by one frame's time per update, so AI time runs at about half speed. items.summary: I don't really think benchmarks are very useful than for wide marketing...
